import re

from shopkit.core.order_engine import formatOrderRef

__all__ = ["order_refs"]

_NON_WORD = r"[^0-9A-Za-z]"

    r"(?P<ord>(?<![0-9A-Za-z_])ORD"

    + _NON_WORD + r"+(?P<so_seq>[0-9]{1,6})(?![0-9A-Za-z_]))",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

def order_refs(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return canonical order references found in text, in first-seen order."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []
    refs: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for match in _ORDER_REF_RE.finditer(text):
        value = match.group("ord_value")
        if value is not None:
            ref = f"ord_{value.lower()}"
        else:
            kind = match.group("so_kind").upper()
            year = int(match.group("so_year"))
            seq = int(match.group("so_seq"))
            if year == 0 or seq == 0:
                continue
            ref = formatOrderRef(kind, year, seq)
        if ref not in seen:
            seen.add(ref)
            refs.append(ref)
    return refs

from __future__ import annotations

import re

from shopkit.core.order_engine import formatOrderRef

__all__ = ["order_refs"]

_NON_WORD = r"[^0-9A-Za-z]"
_ORDER_REF_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?P<ord>(?<![0-9A-Za-z_])ORD"
    + _NON_WORD + r"*(?P<ord_value>[0-9A-Fa-f]{12})(?![0-9A-Za-z_]))"
    r"|(?P<so>(?<![0-9A-Za-z_])(?P<so_kind>SOB|SO)"
    + _NON_WORD + r"*(?P<so_year>[0-9]{4})"
    + _NON_WORD + r"+(?P<so_seq>[0-9]{1,6})(?![0-9A-Za-z_]))",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

def order_refs(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return canonical order references found in text, in first-seen order."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []
    refs: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for match in _ORDER_REF_RE.finditer(text):
        value = match.group("ord_value")
        if value is not None:
            ref = f"ord_{value.lower()}"
        else:
            kind = match.group("so_kind").upper()
            year = int(match.group("so_year"))
            seq = int(match.group("so_seq"))
            if year == 0 or seq == 0:
                continue
            ref = formatOrderRef(kind, year, seq)
        if ref not in seen:
            seen.add(ref)
            refs.append(ref)
    return refs
```
